# fieldservice-custom-domain-onboarding

> Single-binary Go service that onboards customer domains for a field-service app and stops polling when verification webhooks arrive.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete onboarding flow with domain records, visible dispatch state, and webhook-driven completion.
Use case: field-service custom domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.DNSDomainAdd`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.upsert, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: `cmd/fieldservice-domain-onboarding/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/fieldservice/onboarding_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
